q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a water meter?
title: Water meter carbon footprint per meter
short: Weigh the brass or plastic body, the register and the internal parts per meter and multiply by supplier figures, adding electronics for smart meters. Add machining, moulding, assembly and calibration energy, then divide the plant's energy by meters made.

ul: Electronics and battery for smart meters.
Casting or machining brass bodies, or moulding plastic ones.

p: Report per meter by size and body material. A brass body usually carries more footprint than a plastic one of the same size.

example.title: Worked example: plant energy per meter (one month)
lines: Plant total: 35,500 / 40,000 = 0.887 kg CO2 per meter
Add brass or plastic and any electronics for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
